PROPOSAL for the owner: pick, reorder or reword. Each `scene` is a play-shots.mjs scene; a shot with `compose` stacks real captures (crops from..to summing to 1) into one picture. `title` is the big line, `line` the small one. Plain words, no promise the app cannot keep, nothing that reads as official. The first set (seven shots) is in git history of this file.
